title: Tenders floated for elevated corridor from Lighthouse to Thiru. Vi. Ka. Bridge
description: Highways Department calls for consultants to prepare a detailed project report. The corridor will run via Santhome High Road, Greenways Road, and Durgabai Deshmukh Road. It will have two lanes up to 1.8 km, and four lanes for the remaining stretch. The project will take 2 years to complete
